Help.Connect: Choose a device source in Settings and save it, then discover and connect devices in the workspace. Changing the source stops the session and disconnects existing devices.
Help.Discovery: Bluetooth currently supports YYC-DJ / YCY-DJ electrical devices on Windows 10 (2004) or later. If discovery finds nothing, turn on the device, bring it closer, disconnect other control apps, and scan again. The local simulator uses virtual devices and sends no Bluetooth commands.
Help.Linked: In independent mode, only the current device is controlled. To control multiple devices, connect them, check Include in group on their cards, and enable linked mode. The checkbox selects session targets; it does not connect a device. Each device keeps its own output limit.
Help.LiveWave: Use the workspace waveform picker to change waves during a session. The new wave starts from its beginning while devices, strength, and the session timer are preserved.
Help.Output: A session can start with both channels at 0%. Adjust A/B strength while running; each device's output limit still applies. Single-channel devices ignore channel B. Channel B can be offset by half a waveform period.
Help.Readings: Sent strength is the command percentage after limits are applied, not a measured current. The waveform preview shows the configured curve, not a physical device measurement.
Help.StopBehavior: Output starts at zero on launch and reconnection. Changing devices or pages, reaching the time limit, or closing the app stops the session. Esc stops all output.
Help.Disconnection: An unexpected disconnection stops the other linked devices. Software cannot confirm physical output on a lost connection. Reconnect a disconnected device before using it again.
Help.Storage: Sessions are saved locally when they end. History retains the current log and one previous log, each up to 128 KiB; cumulative statistics do not shrink when logs roll. Settings shows the data directory, which contains separate files for statistics, settings, custom waveforms, and sessions.
Help.Timer: Enable the timer and drag the duration slider; arrow keys adjust by one second. Starting a session replaces the slider with shrinking progress and a countdown. With the timer off, the session runs until you stop it.
Help.TimerLimit: Set the slider's upper limit in Settings → Timer duration limit (1–120 minutes). Lowering the limit also shortens a selected duration above it. The timer switch and duration are locked while running.
Help.Waves: Built-in waveforms cannot be deleted or overwritten; copy one to edit it. Custom waveforms support JSON import and export. Electrical devices reject motor waveforms.
History.Help: Sessions are stored in compact JSON Lines. Files roll at 128 KiB; one previous file is kept.
Settings.AppearanceHelp: Theme and accent color follow system settings and update automatically on supported platforms.
Settings.BluetoothHelp: Find YYC-DJ / YCY-DJ electrical devices. Save to apply the device source; switching stops and disconnects existing devices. Currently available on Windows 10 (2004) or later.
